facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_model_config: create a ModelConfig Pydantic model with model_name, provider, max_tokens, temperature, and endpoint settings

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.call_llm_engine: call an LLMEngine instance directly with messages and stop_sequences to get chat completion results

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_generic_litellm_engine: create a generic LiteLLM engine for any provider not explicitly listed

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.list_message_roles: list all available MessageRole values using the roles classmethod to get a list of role strings
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_mmo_observation: create an MMObservation Pydantic model with content string and a list of Attachment objects
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.get_mmo_verbose_output: call the verbose method on an MMObservation instance to get formatted content and attachment MIME and size info
